observed_text_provenance: Second-pass review from the supplied page scan after rereading the project README. The initial geometry was treated as provisional rather than presumptively correct: physical line centres were re-registered from the scan, corrected full-width crops were checked in column overviews, and a final top-to-bottom sweep was used to catch accumulated drift and duplicate/omitted row assignments. The prior review's independent image reading was retained where it still belonged to the same physical line; lines exposed as mis-associated or materially truncated by the corrected geometry were reread directly from the corrected scan. expected_line_version values are preserved unchanged.
geometry_acceptance: Every isolated crop was inspected at full practical size against the full page; complete first and last glyphs and all top/bottom ink were checked, followed by a top-to-bottom sweep of each column for repeated clipping, especially the outer/right edge of column 2. Conservative rule-to-rule width and necessary neighboring-line overlap are allowed.
